title: Conjectures, questions and problems in the intrinsic NA–BT program

scope.field: Fixed original finite K/Q_p and original absolute value
scope.background: symmetric middle-positive separately d-prime and d-double-prime closed
scope.tests: all original compact smooth complementary CLD tests
scope.refinements: all actual original-unit moment refinements, including rank loss
scope.global_energy_domain: strict Laurent box with extending background, unless an explicit domain-extension problem is being posed

status_convention: Theorem inputs retain the status of their source manuscripts. Every item below is open; a sufficient route and a special-case reduction do not close their parent problem.

items.title: Descent of actual analytic relations
items.statement: For every finite K/Q_p with its original norm, every good Hausdorff boundaryless quasi-smooth ordinary germ of pure dimension n, every 1<=b<=n and every finite signed admissible continuous closed-cell PL/PS presentation P with actual delta curvature kappa_b(P)=0, there is an ordinary representative chosen for P on which A_S(P)=0 for every symmetric middle-positive separately d-prime and d-double-prime closed background S of degree p<=n-b, on all original compact smooth complementary CLD tests and all actual refinements including rank loss. Admissible scalars have their existing full delta curvature and are finite differences of continuous classical psh functions.
known_cases: Degree one; potential independence and the continuous-coefficient curvature module.
Quadratic finite presentations with s_f(x)<=2, in arbitrary ambient dimension.
Quadratic normal-three supplied models on the ordinary puncture; central vanishing in specified sufficient cases.
The established local weakly approximable background class, within its testing scope.
items.next_mathematical_step: Prove joint wall-flux cancellation for the realized critical pair; then general-germ return and higher coupled relations.
excluded_variants: Checking a single tropical chart or only a skeleton.
Replacing the original field or norm.
Dropping lower/rank-losing faces.
Concluding variable-PS coefficients, arbitrary current pullback or GK testing solely from the scalar conjecture.

items.title: Cancellation of the realized critical pairing
items.statement: For every supplied original smooth normal-three model germ, finite admissible continuous closed-cell PL/PS quadratic actual zero P, allowed degree-one S and common protected moment presentation, the spherical expression sum c_alpha(integral h_alpha^1 k_alpha^1 d sigma - integral d_S h_alpha^1 tensor d_S k_alpha^1 : d M) is zero. The pair (Z_0,M) must arise jointly from the original relation and background.
known_cases: Vanishing critical density nu.
An actual full-exact leading-energy identity on a neighborhood of the whole protected central fiber.
Each scalar first jet is one ambient linear function.
Previously established bounded-potential and W_loc background cases.
items.next_mathematical_step: Use actual-zero geometry to cancel the critical wall flux while retaining charged coefficient walls and mixed entries.
excluded_variants: Arbitrary real divergence-free PSD spherical measures are analytically realized.
The homogeneous first-jet formal relation is automatically an actual zero.
Finite/critical mass growth alone removes a Dirac residual.
Punctured local primitives automatically glue globally.

items.title: Carrier-CLN vanishing
items.statement: For every actual signed PL-zero germ of mixed degree b>=2, does the unchanged carrier-CLN seminorm q^{U,b}_{F,L}(P) vanish at every required compact stage for the original absolute cap carrier F and the specified harmonic/ordinary-zero-product/ambient-cycle generator space?
known_cases: Degree one.
The forward implication q=0 => all allowed background actions vanish.
The existing harmonic recognition and cap zero-product certificates.
dependencies: Original cap reduction and CLN estimates
items.next_mathematical_step: Construct the unchanged seminorm certificates or determine an actual full-polar obstruction.
excluded_variants: Defining all actual analytic zeros to be generators.
Using the signed relation zero support in place of the absolute carrier.
Equating all seminorm polars with positive backgrounds.
Claiming action descent implies this stronger certificate without proof.

items.title: Local approximation of backgrounds
items.statement: Does every allowed background of degree (p,p) lie in the ordinary-local weak closure W_loc^p of positive separately closed actual delta-form backgrounds on fixed ordinary representatives? Which intrinsic hypotheses characterize that closure?
known_cases: Full actual delta testing in W_loc.
Stability of W_loc under bounded BT tails.
dependencies: Established weak testing continuity on fixed representatives
items.next_mathematical_step: Construct positive closed actual approximants with the required original test convergence, or exhibit a background outside this closure.
excluded_variants: Weak approximation supplied by the definition of the order completion.
Density of all allowed currents inferred from one special model.

items.title: Higher and variable-coefficient differential interfaces
items.statement: Construct the specified graded differential actions for higher coupled analytic relations, variable finite PS coefficients, differential-operator compatibility and the intended delta-form test classes, with exact object sheaves and mapping classes.
known_cases: Bounded current calculus
Continuous-coefficient module and its order completion
Degree-one delta action
Quadratic finite closed-cell PS interface in low residue rank
dependencies: Each specific existing object sheaf and its proven operations
items.next_mathematical_step: Prove each quotient, differential and testing interface separately with its actual boundaries and permitted maps.
excluded_variants: A quadratic result automatically gives higher coupled relations.
Ordinary current equality is equality on every GK delta test.
An arbitrary analytic map pulls back arbitrary currents.

items.title: Borel inner regularity of relative outer capacity
items.statement: For every strict Laurent box V compactly inside an original affinoid interior and every allowed S extending past its closure, is C_S^*(E;V)=sup_{H compact subset E} C_S^*(H;V) for every Borel E subset V? Capacity uses all original classical psh testers 0<=u<=1 on the whole V.
known_cases: Qualified ambient [1] theory.
For q=1, S_0=beta^{n-1}[X] on the analytic torus box, saturated Borel inverse images of finite H^{n-1} sets compactly inside the moment box.
The latter class persists under the stated one-sided positive background order control.
items.next_mathematical_step: Obtain uniform Borel remainder estimates for the actual tester family; handle exhaustion to non-relatively-compact Borel sets.
excluded_variants: Universal raw=outer even on compact sets (false).
Universal strong subadditivity (false).
Universal extremal total-mass calibration (false).
Failure of strong subadditivity alone disproves Borel inner regularity.

items.title: Tester recovery and relative detection
items.statement: Find intrinsic conditions on (V,S) and set classes ensuring actual normalized-tester recovery of intended compact masses and promotion of relative q.e. conclusions to specified pointwise representatives.
known_cases: Ambient and qualified relative comparison results
Finite-Hausdorff saturated range
items.next_mathematical_step: Identify geometric support or approximation hypotheses that imply uniform tester recovery and detection.
excluded_variants: Relative outer-null sets always equal ambient pluripolar sets.
Completed source measures are automatically actual normalized tester measures.

items.title: Literal energy-dual strong continuity
items.statement: For a fixed allowed S on a strict Laurent box, suppose a positive Radon measure annihilates the relative null ideal, all completed Borel differences are literally integrable, and its integral functional is bounded on the entire energy-difference Banach space. Does I(u_j,u)->0 imply integral |u_j-u| d mu ->0 for every strong row? No finite-total-mass hypothesis is added.
known_cases: Source-dominated data
Specified capacity-dominated classes
Existing sufficient ordered-rooftop and finite-minorant reductions
items.next_mathematical_step: Prove fixed-S ordered-rooftop continuity or the weaker finite-minorant sublinear budget, or construct a positive literal datum satisfying all hypotheses that fails continuity.
excluded_variants: The coefficient-one rooftop energy inequality (false).
A uniform energy-only modulus for changing backgrounds (false).
Norm boundedness on one witness row replaces the global ED bound.
A nonliteral dual counterexample settles the literal measure question.

items.title: Checkable compatible source classes
items.statement: For specified (V,S), describe substantial literal positive Radon data classes by conditions on the data, geometry and supplied reference objects, and derive strong continuity plus Xi=0, existence, uniqueness and stability in the prescribed strong completion.
known_cases: Norm-closed source image
Unique variational projection for strong-continuous functionals
Exact Xi normal-probe criterion
Qualified source-compatible data classes
Specified finite-mode inverse results
dependencies: Verified literal strong continuity for the candidate class
items.next_mathematical_step: Identify the range of the linearization at a known reference and prove both inverse estimates and nonlinear stability of its boundary/moment constraints.
excluded_variants: Every smooth positive or small density datum is soluble (false).
Variational maximizer is automatically a source solution.
Strong continuity or source domination by itself implies Xi=0.
Assuming unknown source equality or optimizer sharpness as an input criterion.

items.title: Domain and boundary extension
items.statement: Find geometric domain/background conditions yielding barriers, global Green formula, uniform boundary tightness and an exhaustion theorem preserving no loss, source currents and the specified boundary completion.
known_cases: Strict Laurent boxes with extending backgrounds
Specified affinoid part-form linear domains
items.next_mathematical_step: Replace each use of the Laurent-box hypotheses by explicit geometric estimates.
excluded_variants: Energy-approximation boundary is automatically an ordinary pointwise boundary.
A negative exhaustion function alone supplies every global energy estimate.

items.title: Classical representatives of completed classes
items.statement: Characterize pairs (V,S) and subclasses of the strong completion admitting canonical ambient classical psh representatives, with precise continuity, comparison, boundary and q.e.-to-pointwise detection statements.
known_cases: Actual bounded classical core
Relative Borel realization and quasicontinuity
Bounded potential quotient
items.next_mathematical_step: Connect the curvature quotient and relative capacity through a proved representative theorem.
excluded_variants: Every strong E1 completion member is automatically classical.
Order-current, energy-potential and capacity-Borel completions are interchangeable.

items.title: Relative singularity invariants
items.statement: For explicit actual potential/background classes, determine invariance of non-polar masses, no-loss conditions and energies under bounded changes of singularity; construct envelopes/comparison and specify behavior under permitted proper modifications.
known_cases: No-loss and positive-power energy capacity-tail characterizations
Non-polar products with local coefficient finiteness
items.next_mathematical_step: Start with controlled model singularities and prove truncation-mass stability under a specified modification.
excluded_variants: Ambient polar and relative null are universally identical.
Arbitrary-current pullback is available without a mapping theorem.

items.title: Finite-energy Green products
items.statement: Define Green classes D g_Z + delta_Z = omega_Z with integrable truncation products and local intersection pairings; prove approximation independence, symmetry and agreement with existing smooth/formal/delta theories under explicit intersection hypotheses.
known_cases: Global first-energy Green symmetry
Existing GK and Mihatsch Green constructions
Continuous Chern products in R scope
dependencies: Integrability and proper-intersection or replacement hypotheses
Descent for curvature-generated differential expressions where needed
items.next_mathematical_step: Construct a first energy class of Green expressions and prove the cycle pairing and comparison theorem.
excluded_variants: Main relation descent alone multiplies every arbitrary cycle/current.
Prospective applications are established results.

items.title: Adelic finite-energy intersection
items.statement: For specified adelic metrized line bundles on a quasi-projective variety, extend local finite-energy intersection terms and impose explicit placewise summability and boundary conditions yielding a global approximation-independent pairing with variation, projection and justified positivity.
known_cases: Continuous Chern products and specified local Yuan–Zhang measure positivity
Separate geometric adelic-nefness input under its own hypotheses
items.next_mathematical_step: Prove one local metric-change formula and a summable global domination compatible with the product formula.
excluded_variants: Local current positivity alone implies arithmetic nefness.
A local theorem automatically gives global adelic convergence.

open_sufficient_routes.statement: Construct full-exact approximants to alpha_P with one fixed positive order control before every background/test/refinement.
open_sufficient_routes.known: Sufficiency and the s_f<=2 construction are proved.

open_sufficient_routes.statement: For fixed S, w <=_rel u and u_j -> u strongly, e(P_S(w,u_j)) -> e(w).
open_sufficient_routes.known: Sufficient for the stated literal-continuity problem; changing-background uniformity is false.

open_sufficient_routes.statement: Sublinear energy-root budgets for finite common minorants along the required subsequences.
open_sufficient_routes.known: The existing packing criterion is sufficient; direct finite-family energy bounds would imply it.
